Contrat d'utilisation<p><a name="P22S2241"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2242"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5"><a name="Article 5">Article 5</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2243"></a></p><h4 name="Contenu et forme"><a name="Contenu et forme">Contenu et forme</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2244"></a></p>

§ 1 Les relations entre le gestionnaire et le transporteur ou  toute autre personne autorisée à conclure un contrat de cette  nature conformément aux lois et prescriptions en vigueur dans  l'Etat dans lequel se situe l'infrastructure sont réglées  dans un contrat d'utilisation.<p><a name="P22S2245"></a></p>

§ 2 Le contrat règle les détails nécessaires pour déterminer  les conditions administratives, techniques et financières de  l'utilisation. <p><a name="P22S2246"></a></p>

§ 3 Le contrat doit être constaté par écrit ou sous une forme 
équivalente. L'absence ou l'irrégularité d'une constatation  par écrit ou sous une forme équivalente ou l'absence d'une  des indications prévues au § 2 n'affectent ni l'existence ni  la validité du contrat qui reste soumis aux présentes Règles  uniformes.<p><a name="P22S2247"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2248"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5"><a name="Article 5">Article 5</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2249"></a></p><h4 name="Contenu et forme"><a name="Contenu et forme">Contenu et forme</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2250"></a></p>

§ 1 Les relations entre le gestionnaire et le transporteur ou  toute autre personne autorisée á conclure un contrat de cette  nature conformément aux lois et prescriptions en vigueur dans  l'Etat dans lequel se situe l'infrastructure ferroviaire sont  re´gle´es par un contrat d'utilisation. <p><a name="P22S2251"></a></p>

§ 2 Le contrat règle les détails nécessaires pour déterminer  les conditions administratives, techniques et financières de  l'utilisation.<p><a name="P22S2252"></a></p>

§ 3 Le contrat doit être constaté par écrit ou sous une forme 
équivalente. L'absence ou l'irrégularité d'une constatation  par écrit ou sous une forme équivalente ou l'absence d'une des  indications prévues au § 2 n'affectent ni l'existence ni la  validité du contrat qui reste soumis aux présentes Règles  uniformes.<p><a name="P22S2253"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2254"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5bis"><a name="Article 5bis">Article 5bis</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2255"></a></p><h4 name="Droit non affecté"><a name="Droit non affecté">Droit non affecté</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2256"></a></p>

§ 1 Les dispositions de l'article 5 tout comme celles des  articles 6, 7 et 22 n'affectent pas les obligations que les  parties au contrat d'utilisation de l'infrastructure sont  tenues de remplir conformément aux lois et prescriptions en  vigueur dans l'Etat dans lequel se situe l'infrastructure, y  compris, le cas échéant, le droit de l'Union européenne.<p><a name="P22S2257"></a></p>

§ 2 Les dispositions des articles 8 et 9 n'affectent pas les  obligations que les parties au contrat d'utilisation de  l'infrastructure sont tenues de remplir dans un Etat membre  de l'UE ou dans un Etat où la législation de l'Union  européenne s'applique par suite d'accords internationaux  conclus avec l'Union européenne.<p><a name="P22S2258"></a></p>

§ 3 Les dispositions des §§ 1 et 2 concernent en  particulier:<br />
   - les accords à conclure entre les entreprises ferroviaires  ou les candidats autorisés et les gestionnaires  d'infrastructure,<br />
   - l'octroi des licences,<br />
   - la certification en matière de sécurité,<br />
   - l'assurance,<br />
   - la tarification, y compris les systèmes d'amélioration des  performances afin de réduire au minimum les retards et  perturbations d'exploitation et d'améliorer les performances  du réseau ferroviaire,<br />
   - les mesures d'indemnisation en faveur des clients et<br />
   - le règlement des litiges.<p><a name="P22S2259"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2260"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5bis"><a name="Article 5bis">Article 5bis</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2261"></a></p><h4 name="Droit non affecté"><a name="Droit non affecté">Droit non affecté</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2262"></a></p>

§ 1 Les dispositions de l'article 5 tout comme celles des  articles 6, 7 et 22 n'affectent pas les obligations que les  parties au contrat d'utilisation sont tenues de remplir  conformément aux lois et prescriptions en vigueur dans l'Etat  dans lequel se situe l'infrastructure ferroviaire, y compris,  le cas échéant, le droit de l'Union européenne.<p><a name="P22S2263"></a></p>

§ 2 Les dispositions des articles 8 et 9 n'affectent pas les  obligations que les parties au contrat d'utilisation sont  tenues de remplir dans un Etat membre de l'UE ou dans un Etat  où la é´gislation de l'Union européenne s'applique par suite  d'accords internationaux conclus avec l'Union européenne.<p><a name="P22S2264"></a></p>

§ 3 Les dispositions des §§ 1 et 2 concernent en particulier:<br />
   - les accords à conclure entre les entreprises ferroviaires ou  les candidats autorisés et les gestionnaires d'infrastructure,<br />
   - l'octroi des licences,<br />
   - la certification en matière de sécurité,<br />
   - l'assurance,<br />
   - la tarification, y compris les systèmes d'amélioration des  performances afin de réduire au minimum les retards et  perturbations d'exploitation et d'améliorer les performances  du réseau ferroviaire,<br />
   - les mesures d'indemnisation en faveur des clients et<br />
   - le règlement des litiges.<p><a name="P22S2265"></a></p><h4 name="Article 6"><a name="Article 6">Article 6</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2266"></a></p><h4 name="Obligations particulières du transporteur et du gestionnaire"><a name="Obligations particulières du transporteur et du gestionnaire">Obligations particulières du transporteur et du gestionnaire</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2267"></a></p>

§ 1 Le transporteur doit être autorisé à exercer l'activité  de transporteur ferroviaire. Le personnel à employer et les  véhicules à utiliser doivent répondre aux exigences de  sécurité. Le gestionnaire peut exiger que le transporteur  prouve, par la présentation d'une licence et d'un  certificat de sécurité valables ou de copies certifiées  conformes ou de toute autre manière, que ces conditions sont  remplies.<p><a name="P22S2268"></a></p>

§ 2 Le transporteur doit faire connaître au gestionnaire tout 
événement susceptible d'affecter la validité de sa licence,  de ses certificats de sécurité, ou des autres éléments de  preuve.<p><a name="P22S2269"></a></p>

§ 3 Le gestionnaire peut exiger que le transporteur prouve  qu'il a conclu une assurance-responsabilité suffisante ou  qu'il a pris des dispositions équivalentes pour couvrir  toutes les actions, à quelque titre que ce soit, visées aux  articles 9 à 21. Le transporteur doit prouver annuellement  par une attestation en bonne et due forme que  l'assurance-responsabilité ou les dispositions équivalentes  existent toujours; il doit notifier au gestionnaire toute  modification y relative avant que celle-ci ne produise ses  effets.<p><a name="P22S2270"></a></p>

§ 4 Les parties au contrat doivent s'informer réciproquement  de tout événement susceptible d'empêcher l'exécution du  contrat qu'elles ont conclu.<br />
   ------------------------------------------------------------<p><a name="P22S2271"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2272"></a></p><h4 name="Article 7"><a name="Article 7">Article 7</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2273"></a></p><h4 name="Fin du contrat"><a name="Fin du contrat">Fin du contrat</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2274"></a></p>

§ 1 Le gestionnaire peut dénoncer le contrat d'utilisation  sans délai lorsque:<br />
      a) le transporteur n'est plus autorisé à exercer l'activité  de transporteur ferroviaire;<br />
      b) le personnel à employer et les véhicules à utiliser ne  répondent plus aux exigences de sécurité;<br />
      c) le transporteur est en retard de paiement, à savoir<br />
   1. pour deux échéances successives et avec un montant qui  dépasse une contre-valeur d'usage pour un mois ou<br />
   2. pour un délai couvrant plus de deux échéances et avec un  montant égal à la contre-valeur d'usage pour deux mois;<br />
      d) le transporteur a violé d'une manière caractérisée l'une  des obligations particulières prévues à l'article 6, §§ 2 et 
3.<p><a name="P22S2275"></a></p>

§ 2 Le transporteur peut dénoncer le contrat d'utilisation  sans délai lorsque le gestionnaire perd son droit de gérer  l'infrastructure.<p><a name="P22S2276"></a></p>

§ 3 Chaque partie au contrat d'utilisation peut le dénoncer  sans délai en cas de violation caractérisée d'une des  obligations essentielles par l'autre partie au contrat,  lorsque cette obligation concerne la sécurité des personnes  et des biens; les parties au contrat peuvent convenir des  modalités de l'exercice de ce droit.<p><a name="P22S2277"></a></p>

§ 4 La partie au contrat qui est à l'origine de sa  dénonciation répond envers l'autre partie du dommage qui en  résulte, à moins qu'elle ne prouve que le dommage ne résulte  pas de sa faute.<p><a name="P22S2278"></a></p>

§ 5 Les parties au contrat peuvent convenir de conditions  dérogeant aux dispositions du § 1, lettres c) et d) et du

§ 1 Le gestionnaire est responsable;<br />
      a) des dommages corporels (mort, blessures ou toute autre  atteinte à l'intégrité physique ou psychique),<br />
      b) des dommages matériels (destruction ou avarie des biens  mobiliers et immobiliers),<br />
      c) des dommages pécuniaires résultant des dommages-intérêts  dus par le transporteur en vertu des Règles uniformes CIV et  des Règles uniformes CIM, <p><a name="P22S2298"></a></p>

causés au transporteur ou à ses auxiliaires durant  l'utilisation de l'infrastructure et ayant leur origine dans  l'infrastructure.<p><a name="P22S2299"></a></p>

§ 2 Le gestionnaire est déchargé de cette responsabilité:<br />
      a) en cas de dommages corporels et de dommages pécuniaires  résultant des dommages-intérêts dus par le transporteur en  vertu des Règles uniformes CIV<br />
   1. si l'événement dommage-able a été causé par des  circonstances extérieures à l'exploitation que le  gestionnaire, en dépit de la diligence requise d'après les  particularités de l'espèce, ne pouvait pas éviter et aux  conséquences desquelles il ne pouvait pas obvier,<br />
   2. dans la mesure où l'événement dommageable est dû à une  faute de la personne ayant subi le dommage,<br />
   3. si l'événement dommage-able est dû au comportement d'un  tiers que le gestionnaire, en dépit de la diligence requise  d'après les particularités de l'espèce, ne pouvait pas éviter  et aux conséquences duquel il ne pouvait pas obvier;<br />
      b) en cas de dommages matériels et de dommages pécuniaires  résultant des dommages-intérêts dus par le transporteur en  vertu des Règles uniformes CIM, lorsque le dommage est causé  par la faute du transporteur ou par un ordre du transporteur  qui n'est pas imputable au gestionnaire ou en raison de  circonstances que le gestionnaire ne pouvait pas éviter et  aux conséquences desquelles il ne pouvait pas obvier.<p><a name="P22S2300"></a></p>

§ 3 Si l'événement dommage-able est dû au comportement d'un  tiers et si, en dépit de cela, le gestionnaire n'est pas  entièrement déchargé de sa responsabilité conformément au 
§ 2, lettre a), il répond pour le tout dans les limites des  présentes Règles uniformes et sans préjudice de son recours 
éventuel contre le tiers.<p><a name="P22S2301"></a></p>

§ 4 Les parties au contrat peuvent convenir si, et dans  quelle mesure, le gestionnaire est responsable des dommages  causés au transporteur par un retard ou par une perturbation  dans l'exploitation.<p><a name="P22S2302"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2303"></a></p><h4 name="Article 8"><a name="Article 8">Article 8</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2304"></a></p><h4 name="Responsabilité du gestionnaire"><a name="Responsabilité du gestionnaire">Responsabilité du gestionnaire</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2305"></a></p>

§ 2, lettre a), il répond pour le tout dans les limites des  présentes Règles uniformes et sans préjudice de son recours 
éventuel contre le tiers.<p><a name="P22S2322"></a></p>

§ 4 Les parties au contrat peuvent convenir si, et dans quelle  mesure, le transporteur est responsable des dommages causés au  gestionnaire par une perturbation dans l'exploitation.<p><a name="P22S2334"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2335"></a></p><h4 name="Article 10"><a name="Article 10">Article 10</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2336"></a></p><h4 name="Causes concomitants"><a name="Causes concomitants">Causes concomitants</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2337"></a></p>

§ 1 Lorsque des causes imputables au gestionnaire et des  causes imputables au transporteur ont contribué au dommage,  chaque partie au contrat ne répond que dans la mesure où les  causes qui lui sont imputables en vertu des articles 8 et 9  ont contribué au dommage. S'il est impossible de constater  dans quelle mesure les causes respectives ont contribué au  dommage, chaque partie supporte le dommage qu'elle a subi.<p><a name="P22S2338"></a></p>

§ 2 Le § 1 est applicable par analogie lorsque des causes  imputables au gestionnaire et des causes imputables à  plusieurs transporteurs empruntant la même infrastructure  ferroviaire ont contribué au dommage.<p><a name="P22S2339"></a></p>

§ 3 En cas de dommages visés à l'article 9, le § 1, première  phrase, est applicable par analogie lorsque des causes  imputables à plusieurs transporteurs utilisant la même  infrastructure ont contribué au dommage. S'il est impossible  de constater dans quelle mesure les causes respectives ont  contribué au dommage, les transporteurs sont responsables à  parts égales envers le gestionnaire.<p><a name="P22S2340"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2341"></a></p><h4 name="Article 10"><a name="Article 10">Article 10</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2342"></a></p><h4 name="Causes concomitants"><a name="Causes concomitants">Causes concomitants</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2343"></a></p>

§ 1 Lorsque des causes imputables au gestionnaire et des  causes imputables au transporteur ont contribué au dommage,  chaque partie au contrat ne répond que dans la mesure où les  causes qui lui sont imputables en vertu des articles 8 et 9  ont contribué au dommage. S'il est impossible de constater  dans quelle mesure les causes respectives ont contribué au  dommage, chaque partie supporte le dommage qu'elle a subi.<p><a name="P22S2344"></a></p>

§ 2 Le § 1 est applicable par analogie lorsque des causes  imputables au gestionnaire et des causes imputables à  plusieurs transporteurs empruntant la même infrastructure  ferroviaire ont contribué au dommage.<p><a name="P22S2345"></a></p>

§ 3 En cas de dommages vise´s a` l'article 9, le § 1, premie`re  phrase, est applicable par analogie lorsque des causes  imputables a` plusieurs transporteurs utilisant la me^me  infrastructure ferroviaire ont contribue´ au dommage. S'il est  impossible de constater dans quelle mesure les causes  respectives ont contribue´ au dommage, les transporteurs sont  responsables a` parts e´gales envers le gestionnaire.<p><a name="P22S2346"></a></p><h4 name="Article 11"><a name="Article 11">Article 11</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2347"></a></p><h4 name="Dommages-intérêts en cas de mort"><a name="Dommages-intérêts en cas de mort">Dommages-intérêts en cas de mort</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2348"></a></p>

§ 1 En cas de mort, les dommages-intérêts comprennent:<br />
      a) les frais nécessaires con-sécutifs au décès, notamment  ceux du transport du corps et des obsèques;<br />
      b) si la mort n'est pas survenue immédiatement, les  dommages-intérêts prévus à l'article 12.<p><a name="P22S2349"></a></p>

§ 2 Si, par la mort, des personnes envers lesquelles la  personne décédée avait ou aurait eu à l'avenir une obligation  alimentaire, en vertu de la loi, sont privées de leur  soutien, il y a également lieu de les indemniser de cette  perte. L'action en dommages-intérêts des personnes dont la  personne décédée assumait l'entretien sans y être tenue par  la loi reste soumise au droit national.<br />
   ------------------------------------------------------------<p><a name="P22S2350"></a></p><h4 name="Article 12"><a name="Article 12">Article 12</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2351"></a></p><h4 name="Dommages-intérêts en cas de blessures"><a name="Dommages-intérêts en cas de blessures">Dommages-intérêts en cas de blessures</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2352"></a></p>

En cas de blessures ou de toute autre atteinte à l'intégrité  physique ou psychique, les dommages-intérêts comprennent:<br />
      a) les frais nécessaires, notamment ceux de traitement et de  transport;<br />
      b) la réparation du préjudice causé, soit par l'incapacité de  travail totale ou partielle, soit par l'accroissement des  besoins.<p><a name="P22S2353"></a></p><h4 name="Article 13"><a name="Article 13">Article 13</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2354"></a></p>

Réparation d'autres préjudices corporels<p><a name="P22S2355"></a></p>

Le droit national détermine, si et dans quelle mesure le  gestionnaire ou le transporteur doivent verser des  dommages-intérêts pour des préjudices corporels autres que  ceux prévus aux articles 11 et 12.<p><a name="P22S2356"></a></p><h4 name="Article 14"><a name="Article 14">Article 14</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2357"></a></p><h4 name="Forme et montant des dommages-intérêts en cas de mort et de  blessures"><a name="Forme et montant des dommages-intérêts en cas de mort et de  blessures">Forme et montant des dommages-intérêts en cas de mort et de  blessures</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2358"></a></p>

§ 1 Les dommages-intérêts prévus à l'article 11, § 2 et à  l'article 12, lettre b) doivent être alloués sous forme de  capital. Toutefois, si le droit national permet l'allocation  d'une rente, ils sont alloués sous cette forme lorsque la  personne lésée ou les ayants droit visés à l'article 11, § 2,  le demandent.<p><a name="P22S2359"></a></p>

§ 2 Le montant des dommages-intérêts à allouer en vertu du 
§ 1 est déterminé selon le droit national. Toutefois, pour  l'application des présentes Règles uniformes, il est fixé une  limite maximale de 175 000 unités de compte en capital ou en  rente annuelle correspondant à ce capital, pour chaque  personne, dans le cas où le droit national prévoit une limite  maximale d'un montant inférieur.<p><a name="P22S2360"></a></p><h4 name="Article 15"><a name="Article 15">Article 15</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2361"></a></p>

Déchéance du droit d'invoquer les limites de responsabilité<p><a name="P22S2362"></a></p>

Les limites de responsabilité prévues dans les présentes  Règles uniformes ainsi que les dispositions du droit  national, qui limitent les indemnités à un montant déterminé,  ne s'appliquent pas s'il est prouvé que le dommage résulte  d'un acte ou d'une omission que l'auteur du dommage a commis,  soit avec l'intention de provoquer un tel dommage, soit  témérairement et avec conscience qu'un tel dommage en  résultera probablement.<p><a name="P22S2363"></a></p><h4 name="Article 16"><a name="Article 16">Article 16</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2364"></a></p><h4 name="Conversion et intérêts"><a name="Conversion et intérêts">Conversion et intérêts</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2365"></a></p>

§ 1 Lorsque le calcul de l'indemnité implique la conversion  des sommes exprimées en unités monétaires étrangères,  celle-ci est faite d'après le cours aux jour et lieu du  paiement de l'indemnité.<p><a name="P22S2366"></a></p>

§ 2 L'ayant droit peut demander des intérêts de l'indemnité,  calculés à raison de cinq pour cent l'an, à partir du jour de  l'ouverture d'une procédure de conciliation, du recours au  tribunal arbitral prévu au Titre V de la Convention ou de la  demande en justice.<p><a name="P22S2367"></a></p><h4 name="Article 17"><a name="Article 17">Article 17</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2368"></a></p>

Responsabilité en cas d'accident nucléaire<p><a name="P22S2369"></a></p>

Le gestionnaire et le transporteur sont déchargés de la  responsabilité qui leur incombe en vertu des présentes Règles  uniformes lorsque le dommage a été causé par un accident  nucléaire et qu'en application des lois et prescriptions d'un  Etat réglant la responsabilité dans le domaine de l'énergie  nucléaire, l'exploitant d'une installation nucléaire ou une  autre personne qui lui est substituée est responsable de ce  dommage. <p><a name="P22S2370"></a></p><h4 name="Article 18"><a name="Article 18">Article 18</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2371"></a></p><h4 name="Responsabilité pour les auxiliaries"><a name="Responsabilité pour les auxiliaries">Responsabilité pour les auxiliaries</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2372"></a></p>

Le gestionnaire et le transporteur répondent de leurs  auxiliaires.<p><a name="P22S2373"></a></p><h4 name="Article 19"><a name="Article 19">Article 19</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2374"></a></p><h4 name="Autres actions"><a name="Autres actions">Autres actions</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2375"></a></p>

§ 1 Dans tous les cas où les présentes Règles uniformes  s'appliquent, toute action en responsabilité, à quelque titre  que ce soit, ne peut être exercée contre le gestionnaire ou  contre le transporteur que dans les conditions et limitations  de ces Règles uniformes.<p><a name="P22S2376"></a></p>

§ 2 Il en est de même pour toute action exercée contre les  auxiliaires dont le gestionnaire ou le transporteur répondent  en vertu de l'article 18.<p><a name="P22S2377"></a></p><h4 name="Article 20"><a name="Article 20">Article 20</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2378"></a></p><h4 name="Accords-litiges"><a name="Accords-litiges">Accords-litiges</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2379"></a></p>

Les parties au contrat peuvent convenir des conditions dans  lesquelles elles font valoir ou renoncent à faire valoir  leurs droits aux dommages-intérêts à l'égard de l'autre  partie au contrat.<p><a name="P22S2380"></a></p><h4 name="Titre IV"><a name="Titre IV">Titre IV</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2381"></a></p><h4 name="Actions des auxiliaries"><a name="Actions des auxiliaries">Actions des auxiliaries</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2382"></a></p><h4 name="Article 21"><a name="Article 21">Article 21</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2383"></a></p><h4 name="Actions contre le gestionnaire ou contre le transporteur"><a name="Actions contre le gestionnaire ou contre le transporteur">Actions contre le gestionnaire ou contre le transporteur</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2384"></a></p>

§ 1 Toute action en responsabilité des auxiliaires du  transporteur contre le gestionnaire pour des dommages causés  par celui-ci, à quelque titre que ce soit, ne peut être  exercée que dans les conditions et limitations des présentes  Règles uniformes.<p><a name="P22S2385"></a></p>

§ 2 Toute action en responsabilité des auxiliaires du  gestionnaire contre le transporteur pour des dommages causés  par celui-ci, à quelque titre que ce soit, ne peut être  exercée que dans les conditions et limitations des présentes  Règles uniformes.<p><a name="P22S2386"></a></p><h4 name="Titre V"><a name="Titre V">Titre V</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2387"></a></p><h4 name="Exercice des droits"><a name="Exercice des droits">Exercice des droits</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2388"></a></p><h4 name="Article 22"><a name="Article 22">Article 22</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2389"></a></p><h4 name="Procédure de conciliation"><a name="Procédure de conciliation">Procédure de conciliation</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2390"></a></p>

Les parties au contrat peuvent convenir de procédures de  conciliation ou faire appel au tribunal arbitral prévu au  Titre V de la Convention.<p><a name="P22S2391"></a></p><h4 name="Article 23"><a name="Article 23">Article 23</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2392"></a></p><h4 name="Recours"><a name="Recours">Recours</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2393"></a></p>

Le bien-fondé du paiement effectué par le transporteur sur la  base des Règles uniformes CIV ou des Règles uniformes CIM ne  peut être contesté, lorsque l'indemnité a été fixée  judiciairement et que le gestionnaire, dûment assigné, a été  mis à même d'intervenir au procès.<p><a name="P22S2394"></a></p><h4 name="Article 24"><a name="Article 24">Article 24</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2395"></a></p><h4 name="For"><a name="For">For</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2396"></a></p>

§ 1 Les actions judiciaires fondées sur les présentes Règles  uniformes peuvent être intentées devant les juridictions des  Etats membres désignées d'un commun accord par les parties au  contrat.<p><a name="P22S2397"></a></p>

§ 2 Sauf convention contraire entre les parties, la  juridiction compétente est celle de l'Etat membre où le  gestionnaire a son siège.<p><a name="P22S2398"></a></p><h4 name="Article 25"><a name="Article 25">Article 25</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2399"></a></p><h4 name="Prescription"><a name="Prescription">Prescription</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2400"></a></p>

§ 1 Les actions fondées sur les présentes Règles uniformes  sont prescrites par trois ans.<p><a name="P22S2401"></a></p>

§ 2 La prescription court à compter du jour où le dommage  s'est produit.<p><a name="P22S2402"></a></p>

§ 3 En cas de mort de personnes, les actions sont prescrites  par trois ans à compter du lendemain du décès, sans que ce  délai puisse toutefois dépasser cinq ans à compter du  lendemain de l'événement dommageable.<p><a name="P22S2403"></a></p>

§ 4 Une action récursoire d'une personne tenue responsable  pourra être exercée même après l'expiration du délai de  prescription prévu au § 1, si elle l'est dans le délai  déterminé par la loi de l'Etat où les poursuites sont  engagées. Toutefois, ce délai ne pourra être inférieur à  quatre-vingt-dix jours à compter de la date à laquelle la  personne qui exerce l'action récursoire a réglé la  réclamation ou a elle-même reçu signification de  l'assignation.<p><a name="P22S2404"></a></p>

§ 5 La prescription est suspendue lorsque les parties au  litige conviennent d'une procédure de conciliation ou  lorsqu'elles saisissent le tribunal arbitral prévu au Titre V  de la Convention.<p><a name="P22S2405"></a></p>

§ 6 Par ailleurs, la suspension et l'interruption de la  prescription sont réglées par le droit national.<p><a name="P22S2406"></a></p>

Uniform Rules concerning the Contract of Use of  Infrastructure in International Rail Traffic (CUI, appendix E  to the Convention)<br />
   ------------------------------------------------------------<p><a name="P22S2407"></a></p><h4 name="Title I"><a name="Title I">Title I</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2408"></a></p><h4 name="General Provisions"><a name="General Provisions">General Provisions</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2409"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2410"></a></p><h4 name="Article 1"><a name="Article 1">Article 1</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2411"></a></p><h4 name="Scope"><a name="Scope">Scope</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2412"></a></p>

§ 1 These Uniform Rules shall apply to any contract of use of  railway infrastructure for the purposes of international  carriage within the meaning of the CIV Uniform Rules and the  CIM Uniform Rules. They shall apply regardless of the place  of business and the nationality of the contracting parties.  These Uniform Rules shall apply even when the railway  infrastructure is managed or used by States or by  governmental institutions or organisations.<p><a name="P22S2413"></a></p>

§ 2 Subject to Article 21, these Uniform Rules shall not  apply to other legal relations, such as in particular<br />
      a) the liability of the carrier or the manager to their  servants or other persons whose services they make use of to  accomplish their tasks;<br />
      b) the liability to each other of the carrier or the manager  of the one part and third parties of the other part.<p><a name="P22S2414"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2415"></a></p><h4 name="Article 1"><a name="Article 1">Article 1</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2416"></a></p><h4 name="Scope"><a name="Scope">Scope</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2417"></a></p>

§ 1 These Uniform Rules shall apply to any contract  of use of railway infrastructure (contract of use) in a Member  State in international railway traffic for the purposes of  international carriage within the meaning of the CIV Uniform  Rules and the CIM Uniform Rules.<p><a name="P22S2418"></a></p>

§ 2 These Uniform Rules shall apply irrespective of  the place of business or the nationality of the contracting  parties and even when the railway infrastructure is managed or  used by States or by governmental institutions or  organisations.<p><a name="P22S2419"></a></p>

§ 3 Subject to Article 21, these Uniform  Rules shall not apply to other legal relations, such as in  particular<p><a name="P22S2420"></a></p><pre>a)	the liability of the carrier or the manager </pre>
to their servants or other persons whose services they make 
<pre>use of to accomplish their tasks;	a)	transportörens </pre>
eller förvaltarens ansvar gentemot sina anställda eller andra  personer vilkas tjänster de anlitar för att genomföra sina  uppgifter,<p><a name="P22S2421"></a></p><pre>b)      the liability to each other of the carrier or the </pre>
manager of the one part and third parties of the other part.<p><a name="P22S2422"></a></p><h4 name="Article 2"><a name="Article 2">Article 2</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2423"></a></p><h4 name="Declaration concerning liability in case of bodily loss or  damage"><a name="Declaration concerning liability in case of bodily loss or  damage">Declaration concerning liability in case of bodily loss or  damage</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2424"></a></p>

§ 1 Any State may, at any time, declare that it will not  apply to victims of accidents occuring in its territory the  whole of the provisions concerning liability in case of  bodily loss or damage (death, injury or any other physical or  mental harm), when the victims are nationals of, or have  their usual place of residence in, that State.<p><a name="P22S2425"></a></p>

§ 2 A State which has made a declaration in accordance with 
§ 1 may withdraw it at any time by notification to the  Depositary. This withdrawal shall take effect one month after  the day on which the Depositary notifies it to the Member  States.<p><a name="P22S2426"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2427"></a></p><h4 name="Article 3"><a name="Article 3">Article 3</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2428"></a></p><h4 name="Definitions"><a name="Definitions">Definitions</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2429"></a></p>

For the purposes of these Uniform Rules, the term<br />
      a) "railway infrastructure" means all the railway lines and  fixed installations, so far as these are necessary for the  circulation of railway vehicles and the safety of traffic;<br />
      b) "manager" means the person who makes railway  infrastructure available and who has responsibilities in  accordance with the laws and prescriptions in force in the  State in which the infrastructure is located;<br />
      c) "carrier" means the person who carries persons or goods by  rail in international traffic under the CIV Uniform Rules or  the CIM Uniform Rules and who is licensed in accordance with  the laws and prescriptions relating to licensing and  recognition of licenses in force in the State in which the  person undertakes this activity;<br />
      d) "auxiliary" means the servants or other persons whose  services the carrier or the manager makes use of for the  performance of the contract when these servants or other  persons are acting within the scope of their functions;<br />
      e) "third party" means any person other than the manager, the  carrier and their auxiliaries;<br />
      f) "licence" means the authorisation issued by a State to a  railway undertaking, in accordance with the laws and  prescriptions in force in that State, by which its capacity  as a carrier is recognized;<br />
      g) "safety certificate" means the document attesting, in  accordance with the laws and prescriptions of the State in  which the infrastructure islocated, that so far as concerns  the carrier,<br />
   - the internal organisation of the undertaking as well as<br />
   - the personnel to be employed and the vehicles to be used on  the infrastructure, <p><a name="P22S2430"></a></p>

meet the requirements imposed in respect of safety in order  to ensure a service without danger on that infrastructure.<p><a name="P22S2431"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2432"></a></p><h4 name="Article 3"><a name="Article 3">Article 3</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2433"></a></p><h4 name="Definitions"><a name="Definitions">Definitions</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2434"></a></p>

For the purposes of these Uniform Rules, the term<p><a name="P22S2435"></a></p>

a)"railway  infrastructure" means all the railway lines and fixed  installations, so far as these are necessary for the  circulation of railway vehicles and the safety of traffic;<p><a name="P22S2436"></a></p>

aa)"international railway traffic" means traffic which  requires the use of an international train path or several  successive national train paths situated in at least two  States and coordinated by the infrastructure managers or  the bodies in charge of allocation of train paths that  are concerned;<p><a name="P22S2437"></a></p>

b)"manager" means the person who makes railway  infrastructure available and who has responsibilities in  accordance with the laws and prescriptions in force in the  State in which the railway infrastructure is located;<p><a name="P22S2438"></a></p>

c)"carrier" means the natural or legal person which  carries persons and/or goods by rail in international railway  traffic and which is licensed in accordance with the laws and  prescriptions relating to licensing and recognition of  licenses in force in the State in which the person undertakes  this activity;<p><a name="P22S2439"></a></p>

d)"auxiliary" means the servants or other persons whose  services the carrier or the manager makes use of for the  performance of the contract when these servants or other  persons are acting within the scope of their functions;<p><a name="P22S2440"></a></p>

e)"third party" means any person other than the manager, the carrier and their auxiliaries;<p><a name="P22S2441"></a></p>

f)"licence" means the authorisation issued by a State to a  railway undertaking, in accordance with the laws and  prescriptions in force in that State, by which its capacity as  a carrier is recognized;<p><a name="P22S2442"></a></p>

g)"safety certifycate" means the document attesting, in  accordance with the laws and prescriptions in force in the  State in which the railway infrastructure is located, that so far as concerns the carrier,<br />
   -the internal organisation of the undertaking as well as<br />
   - the personnel to be employed and the vehicles to be used on the railway infrastructure,<br />
meet the requirements imposed in respect of  safety in order to ensure a service without danger on that  railway infrastructure.<p><a name="P22S2443"></a></p><h4 name="Article 4"><a name="Article 4">Article 4</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2444"></a></p><h4 name="Mandatory law"><a name="Mandatory law">Mandatory law</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2445"></a></p>

Unless provided otherwise in these Uniform Rules, any  stipulation which, directly or indirectly, would derogate  from these Uniform Rules, shall be null and void. The nullity  of such a stipulation shall not involve the nullity of other  provisions of the contract. Nevertheless, the parties to the  contract may assume a liability greater and obligations more  burdensome than those provided for in these Uniform Rules or  fix a maximum amount of compensation for loss of or damage to  property.<p><a name="P22S2446"></a></p><h4 name="Title II"><a name="Title II">Title II</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2447"></a></p><h4 name="Contract of Use"><a name="Contract of Use">Contract of Use</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2448"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2449"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5"><a name="Article 5">Article 5</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2450"></a></p><h4 name="Contents and form"><a name="Contents and form">Contents and form</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2451"></a></p>

§ 1 Relations between the manager and the carrier or any  other person entitled to enter into such a contract under the  laws and prescriptions in force in the State in which the  infrastructure is located shall be regulated in a contract of  use.<p><a name="P22S2452"></a></p>

§ 2 The contract shall regulate the necessary details for the  determination of the administrative, technical and financial  conditions of use.<p><a name="P22S2453"></a></p>

§ 3 The contract must be concluded in writing or in an  equivalent form. The absence or irregularity of a written  form or equivalent form of contract or the absence of one of  the matters specified in § 2 shall not affect the existence  or the validity of the contract which shall remain subject to  these Uniform Rules.<p><a name="P22S2454"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2455"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5"><a name="Article 5">Article 5</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2456"></a></p><h4 name="Contents and form"><a name="Contents and form">Contents and form</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2457"></a></p>

§ 1 Relations between the manager and the carrier or  any other person entitled to enter into such a contract under  the laws and prescripttions in force in the State in which the  railway infrastructure is located shall be regulated in a  contract of use.<p><a name="P22S2458"></a></p>

§ 2 The contract shall regulate the necessary details for the determination of the administrative, technical and financial conditions of use.<p><a name="P22S2459"></a></p>

§ 3 The contract must be concluded in writing or in  an equivalent form. The absence or irregularity of a written  form or equivalent form of contract or the absence of one of  the matters specified in § 2 shall not affect the existence or  the validity of the contract which shall remain subject to  these Uniform Rules.<p><a name="P22S2460"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2461"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5bis"><a name="Article 5bis">Article 5bis</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2462"></a></p><h4 name="Law remaining unaffected"><a name="Law remaining unaffected">Law remaining unaffected</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2463"></a></p>

§ 1 The provisions of Article 5 as well as those of Articles 
6, 7 and 22 shall not affect the obligations which the  parties to the contract of use of infrastructure have to meet  under the laws and prescriptions in force in the State in  which the infrastructure is located including, where  appropriate, the law of the European Union.<p><a name="P22S2464"></a></p>

§ 2 The provisions of Articles 8 and 9 shall not affect the  obligations which the parties to the contract of use of  infrastructure have to meet in an EU Member State or in a  State where legislation of the European Union applies as a  result of international agreements with the European Union.<p><a name="P22S2465"></a></p>

§ 3 The provisions of §§ 1 and 2 concern in particular:<br />
   - agreements to be concluded between railway undertakings or  authorised applicants and infrastructure managers,<br />
   - licensing,<br />
   - safety certification,<br />
   - insurance,<br />
   - charging involving performance schemes to minimise delays  and disruptions and improve the performance of the railway  network,<br />
   - compensation arrangements in favour of customers and<br />
   - dispute resolution.<p><a name="P22S2466"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2467"></a></p><h4 name="Article 5bis"><a name="Article 5bis">Article 5bis</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2468"></a></p><h4 name="Law remaining unaffected"><a name="Law remaining unaffected">Law remaining unaffected</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2469"></a></p>

§ 1 The provisions of Article 5 as well as those of  Articles 6, 7 and 22 shall not affect the obligations which  the parties to the contract of use have to meet under the laws  and prescripttions in force in the State in which the railway  infrastructure is located including, where appropriate, the  law of the European Union.<p><a name="P22S2470"></a></p>

§ 2 The provisions of Articles 8 and 9 shall not  affect the obligations which the parties to the contract of  use have to meet in an EU Member State or in a State where  legislation of the European Union applies as a result of  international agreements with the European Union.<p><a name="P22S2471"></a></p>

§ 3 The provisions of §§ 1 and 2 concern in particular:<br />
   - agreements to be concluded between railway undertakings or authorised applicants and infrastructure managers,<br />
   - licensing,<br />
   - safety certification,<br />
   - insurance,<br />
   - charging involving performance schemes to minimise delays and disruptions and improve the performance of the railway network,<br />
   - compensation arrangements in favour of customers and<br />
   - dispute resolution.<p><a name="P22S2472"></a></p><h4 name="Article 6"><a name="Article 6">Article 6</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2473"></a></p><h4 name="Special obligations of the carrier and the manager"><a name="Special obligations of the carrier and the manager">Special obligations of the carrier and the manager</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2474"></a></p>

§ 1 The carrier must be authorised to undertake the activity  of a carrier by rail. The personnel to be employed and the  vehicles to be used must satisfy the safety requirements. The  manager may require the carrier to prove, by the presentation  of a valid licence and safety certificate or certified  copies, or in any other manner, that these conditions are  fulfilled.<p><a name="P22S2475"></a></p>

§ 2 The carrier must notify the manager of any event which  might affect the validity of his licence, his safety  certificates or other elements of proof.<p><a name="P22S2476"></a></p>

§ 3 The manager may require the carrier to prove that he has  taken out a sufficient liability insurance or taken  equivalent measures to cover any claims, on whatever grounds,  referred to in Articles 9 to 21. Each year, the carrier must  prove, by an attestation in due form, that the liability  insurance or the equivalent provisions still exist; he must  notify the manager of any modification relating to them  before it takes effect.<p><a name="P22S2477"></a></p>

§ 4 The parties to the contract must inform each other of any  event which might impede the execution of the contract they  have concluded.<br />
   ------------------------------------------------------------
<i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2478"></a></p><h4 name="Article 7"><a name="Article 7">Article 7</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2479"></a></p><h4 name="Termination of the contract"><a name="Termination of the contract">Termination of the contract</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2480"></a></p>

§ 1 The manager may rescind the contract forthwith when<br />
      a) the carrier is no longer authorised to carry on the  activity of carrier by rail;<br />
      b) the personnel to be employed and the vehicles to be used  no longer meet the safety requirements;<br />
      c) the carrier is in arrear with payment, that is to say<br />
   1. for two successive payment periods and for an amount in  excess of the equivalent of one month's use, or<br />
   2. for a period covering more than two payment periods and  for an amount equal to the value of two months' use;<br />
      d) the carrier is in clear breach of one of the special  obligations specified in Article 6 §§ 2 and 3.<p><a name="P22S2481"></a></p>

§ 2 The carrier may rescind the contract of use forthwith  when the manager loses his right to manage the  infrastructure.<p><a name="P22S2482"></a></p>

§ 3 Each party to the contract may rescind the contract of  use forthwith in the case of a clear breach of one of the  essential obligations by the other party to the contract,  when that obligation concerns the safety of persons or goods;  the parties to the contract may agree the modalities for the  exercise of this right.<p><a name="P22S2483"></a></p>

§ 4 The party to the contract who is the cause of its  rescission shall be liable to the other party for the loss or  damage resulting from it, unless he proves that the loss or  damage was not caused by his fault.<p><a name="P22S2484"></a></p>

§ 5 The parties to the contract may agree conditions  derogating from the provisions of § 1 letters c) and d) and 
§ 4.<p><a name="P22S2485"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2486"></a></p><h4 name="Article 7"><a name="Article 7">Article 7</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2487"></a></p><h4 name="Termination of the contract"><a name="Termination of the contract">Termination of the contract</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2488"></a></p>

§ 1 The manager may rescind the contract forthwith when<br />
      a) the carrier is no longer authorised to carry on the activity of carrier by rail;<br />
      b) the personnel to be employed and the vehicles to be used no longer meet the safety requirements;<br />
      c) the carrier is in arrear with payment, that is to say<br />
   1. for two successive payment periods and for an amount in  excess of the equivalent of one month's use, or<br />
   2. for a period covering more than two payment periods and  for an amount equal to the value of two months' use;<br />
      d) the carrier is in clear breach of one of the special  obligations specified in Article 6 §§ 2 and 3.<p><a name="P22S2489"></a></p>

§ 2 The carrier may rescind the contract of use forthwith when the manager loses his right to manage the railway  infrastructure. <p><a name="P22S2490"></a></p>

§ 3 Each party to the contract may rescind the contract of use forthwith in the case of a clear breach of one of the essential obligations by the other party to the contract, when that obligation concerns the safety of persons or goods;
the parties to the contract may agree the modalities for the  exercise of this right.<p><a name="P22S2491"></a></p>

§ 4 The party to the contract who is the cause of its  rescission shall be liable to the other party for the loss or  damage resulting from it, unless he proves that the loss or  damage was not caused by his fault.<p><a name="P22S2492"></a></p>

§ 5 The parties to the contract may agree conditions derogating from the provisions of § 1 letters c) and d) and § 4.<p><a name="P22S2493"></a></p><h4 name="Title III"><a name="Title III">Title III</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2494"></a></p><h4 name="Liability"><a name="Liability">Liability</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2495"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2496"></a></p><h4 name="Article 8"><a name="Article 8">Article 8</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2497"></a></p><h4 name="Liability of the manager"><a name="Liability of the manager">Liability of the manager</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2498"></a></p>

§ 1 The manager shall be liable<br />
      a) for bodily loss or damage (death, injury or any other  physical or mental harm),<br />
      b) for loss of or damage to property (destruction of, or  damage to, movable or immovable property),<br />
      c) for pecuniary loss resulting from damages payable by the  carrier under the CIV Uniform Rules and the CIM Uniform  Rules, <p><a name="P22S2499"></a></p>

caused to the carrier or to his auxiliaries during the use of  the infrastructure and having its origin in the  infrastructure.<p><a name="P22S2500"></a></p>

§ 2 The manager shall be relieved of this liability<br />
      a) in case of bodily loss or damage and pecuniary loss  resulting from damages payable by the carrier under the CIV  Uniform Rules<br />
   1. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage has been  caused by circumstances not connected with the management of  the infrastructure which the manager, in spite of having  taken the care required in the particular circumstances of  the case, could not avoid and the consequences of which he  was unable to prevent,<br />
   2. to the extent that the incident giving rise to the loss or  damage is due to the fault of the person suffering the loss  or damage,<br />
   3. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due  to the behaviour of a third party which the manager, in spite  of having taken the care required in the particular  circumstances of the case, could not avoid and the  consequences of which he was unable to prevent;<br />
      b) in case of loss of or damage to property and pecuniary  loss resulting from damages payable by the carrier under the  CIM Uniform Rules, when the loss or damage was caused by the  fault of the carrier or by an order given by the carrier  which is not attributable to the manager or by circumstances  which the manager could not avoid and the consequences of  which he was unable to prevent.<p><a name="P22S2501"></a></p>

§ 3 If the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due  to the behaviour of a third party and if, in spite of that,  the manager is not entirely relieved of liability in  accordance with § 2, letter a), he shall be liable in full up  to the limits laid down in these Uniform Rules but without  prejudice to any right of recourse against the third party.<p><a name="P22S2502"></a></p>

§ 4 The parties to the contract may agree whether and to what  extent the manager shall be liable for the loss or damage  caused to the carrier by delay or disruption to his  operations.<p><a name="P22S2503"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2504"></a></p><h4 name="Article 8"><a name="Article 8">Article 8</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2505"></a></p><h4 name="Liability of the manager"><a name="Liability of the manager">Liability of the manager</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2506"></a></p><pre>§ 1 The manager shall be liable	</pre>

a) for bodily loss or damage (death, injury or any other  physical or mental harm),<br />
      b) for loss of or damage to property (destructtion of, or damage to, movable or immovable property),<br />
caused to the carrier or to his auxiliaries during the use of  the railway infrastructure and having its origin in the 
<pre>railway infrastructure.	</pre>

The manager shall also be liable for pecuniary loss  resulting from damages payable by the carrier under the CIV  Uniform Rules and the CIM Uniform Rules when such loss has its  origin in the railway infrastructure while it is being used.<p><a name="P22S2507"></a></p>

§ 2 The manager shall be relieved of this liability<br />
      a) in case of bodily loss or damage and pecuniary loss  resulting from damages payable by the carrier under the CIV  Uniform Rules<br />
   1. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage has been caused by circumstances not connected with the management of  the railway infrastructure which the manager, in spite of having taken the care required in the particular  circumstances of the case, could not avoid and the  consequences of which he was unable to prevent,<br />
   2. to the extent that the incident giving rise to the  loss or damage is due to the fault of the person suffering the  loss or damage,<br />
   3. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due to the behaviour of a third party which the manager, in spite of having taken the care required in the particular circumstances of the case, could not avoid and the consequences of which he was unable to prevent;<br />
      b) in case of loss of or damage to property and pecuniary loss resulting from damages payable by the carrier under the CIM Uniform Rules, when the loss or damage was caused by the fault of the carrier or by an order given by the carrier which is not attributable to the manager or by circumstances which  the manager could not avoid and the consequences of which he was unable to prevent.<p><a name="P22S2508"></a></p>

§ 3 If the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due  to the behaviour of a third party and if, in spite of that,  the manager is not entirely relieved of liability in  accordance with § 2, letter a), he shall be liable in full up to the limits laid down in these Uniform Rules but without prejudice to any right of recourse against the third party.<p><a name="P22S2509"></a></p>

§ 4 The parties to the contract may agree whether and to what extent the manager shall be liable for the loss or damage caused to the carrier by delay or disruption to his operations.<p><a name="P22S2510"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2511"></a></p><h4 name="Article 9"><a name="Article 9">Article 9</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2512"></a></p><h4 name="Liability of the carrier"><a name="Liability of the carrier">Liability of the carrier</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2513"></a></p>

§ 1 The carrier shall be liable<br />
      a) for bodily loss or damage (death, injury or any other  physical or mental harm),<br />
      b) for loss of or damage to property (destructtion of or  damage to movable or immovable property), <p><a name="P22S2514"></a></p>

caused to the manager or to his auxiliaries, during the use  of the infrastructure, by the means of transport used or by  the persons or goods carried.<p><a name="P22S2515"></a></p>

§ 2 The carrier shall be relieved of this liability<br />
      a) in case of bodily loss or damage<br />
   1. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage has been  caused by circumstances not connected with the operations of  the carrier which he, in spite of having taken the care  required in the particular circumstances of the case, could  not avoid and the consequences of which he was unable to  prevent,<br />
   2. to the extent that the incident giving rise to the loss or  damage is due to the fault of the person suffering the loss  or damage,<br />
   3. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due  to the behaviour of a third party which the carrier, in spite  of having taken the care required in the particular  circumstances of the case, could not avoid and the  consequences of which he was unable to prevent;<br />
      b) in case of loss of or damage to property when the loss or  damage is caused by a fault of the manager or by an order  given by the manager which is not attributable to the carrier  or by circumstances which the carrier could not avoid and the  consequences of which he was unable to prevent.<p><a name="P22S2516"></a></p>

§ 3 If the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due  to the behaviour of a third party and if, in spite of that,  the carrier is not entirely relieved of liability in  accordance with § 2, letter a), he shall be liable in full up  to the limits laid down in these Uniform Rules but without  prejudice to any right of recourse against the third party.<p><a name="P22S2517"></a></p>

§ 4 The parties to the contract may agree whether and to what  extent the carrier shall be liable for the loss or damage  caused to the manager by disruption to his operations.<p><a name="P22S2518"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2519"></a></p><h4 name="Article 9"><a name="Article 9">Article 9</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2520"></a></p><h4 name="Liability of the carrier"><a name="Liability of the carrier">Liability of the carrier</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2521"></a></p><pre>§ 1 The carrier shall be liable	</pre>

a) for bodily loss or damage (death, injury or any other  physical or mental harm),<br />
      b) for loss of or damage to property (destructtion of or  damage to movable or immovable property),<br />
caused to the manager or to his auxiliaries, during  the use of the railway infrastructure, by the means of  transport used or by the persons or goods carried.<p><a name="P22S2522"></a></p>

§ 2 The carrier shall be relieved of this liability<br />
      a) in case of bodily loss or damage<br />
   1. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage has been caused by circumstances not connected with the operations of the carrier which he, in spite of having taken the care  required in the particular circumstances of the case, could not avoid and the consequences of which he was unable to prevent,<br />
   2. to the extent that the incident giving rise to the loss  or damage is due to the fault of the person suffering the loss or damage,<br />
   3. if the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due to the behaviour of a third party which the carrier, in spite of  having taken the care required in the particular circumstances  of the case, could not avoid and the consequences of which he was unable to prevent;<br />
      b) in case of loss of or damage to property when the loss or damage is caused by a fault of the manager or by an order  given by the manager which is not attributable to the carrier or by circumstances which the carrier could not avoid and the consequences of which he was unable to prevent.<p><a name="P22S2523"></a></p>

§ 3 If the incident giving rise to the loss or damage is due to the behaviour of a third party and if, in spite of that, the carrier is not entirely relieved of liability in  accordance with § 2, letter a), he shall be liable in full up to the limits laid down in these Uniform Rules but without prejudice to any right of recourse against the third party.<p><a name="P22S2524"></a></p>

§ 4 The parties to the contract may agree whether and to what extent the carrier shall be liable for the loss or damage caused to the manager by disruption to his operations.<p><a name="P22S2525"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2526"></a></p><h4 name="Article 10"><a name="Article 10">Article 10</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2527"></a></p><h4 name="Concomitant causes"><a name="Concomitant causes">Concomitant causes</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2528"></a></p>

§ 1 If causes attributable to the manager and causes  attributable to the carrier contributed to the loss or  damage, each party to the contract shall be liable only to  the extent that the causes attributable to him under Article 
8 and 9 contributed to the loss or damage. If it is  impossible to assess to what extent the respective causes  contributed to the loss or damage, each party shall bear the  loss or damage he has sustained.<p><a name="P22S2529"></a></p>

§ 2 § 1 shall apply mutatis mutandis if causes attributable  to the manager and causes attributable to several carriers  using the same railway infrastructure contributed to the loss  or damage.<p><a name="P22S2530"></a></p>

§ 3 § 1, first sentence, shall apply mutatis mutandis in case  of loss or damage referred to in Article 9 if causes  attributable to several carriers using the same  infrastructure contributed to the loss or damage. If it is  impossible to assess to what extent the respective causes  contributed to the loss or damage, the carriers shall be  liable to the manager in equal shares.<p><a name="P22S2531"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2532"></a></p><h4 name="Article 10"><a name="Article 10">Article 10</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2533"></a></p><h4 name="Concomitant causes"><a name="Concomitant causes">Concomitant causes</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2534"></a></p>

§ 1 If causes attributable to the manager and causes  attributable to the carrier contributed to the loss or damage,  each party to the contract shall be liable only to the extent  that the causes attributable to him under Article 8 and 9  contributed to the loss or damage. If it is impossible to  assess to what extent the respective causes contributed to the  loss or damage, each party shall bear the loss or damage he  has sustained.<p><a name="P22S2535"></a></p>

§ 2 § 1 shall apply mutatis mutandis if causes attributable  to the manager and causes attributable to several carriers  using the same railway infrastructure contributed to the loss or damage.<p><a name="P22S2536"></a></p>

§ 3 § 1, first sentence, shall apply mutatis mutandis in case of loss or damage referred to in Article 9 if causes  attributable to several carriers using the same railway infrastructure contributed to the loss or damage. If it is  impossible to assess to what extent the respective causes  contributed to the loss or damage, the carriers shall be  liable to the manager in equal shares.<p><a name="P22S2537"></a></p><h4 name="Article 11"><a name="Article 11">Article 11</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2538"></a></p><h4 name="Damages in case of death"><a name="Damages in case of death">Damages in case of death</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2539"></a></p>

§ 1 In case of death, the damages shall comprise:<br />
      a) any necessary costs following the death, in particular  those of transport of the body and the funeral expenses;<br />
      b) if death does not occur at once, the damages provided for  in Article 12.<p><a name="P22S2540"></a></p>

§ 2 If, through the death, persons whom the deceased had or  would have had in the future a legal duty to maintain, are  deprived of their support, they shall also be compensated for  that loss. Rights of action for damages by persons whom the  deceased was maintaining without being legally bound to do  so, shall be governed by national law.<p><a name="P22S2541"></a></p><h4 name="Article 12"><a name="Article 12">Article 12</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2542"></a></p><h4 name="Damages in case of personal injury"><a name="Damages in case of personal injury">Damages in case of personal injury</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2543"></a></p>

In case of personal injury or any other physical or mental  harm, the damages shall comprise:<br />
      a) any necessary costs, in particular those of treatment and  of transport;<br />
      b) compensation for financial loss, due to total or partial  incapacity to work, or to increased needs.<p><a name="P22S2544"></a></p><h4 name="Article 13"><a name="Article 13">Article 13</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2545"></a></p><h4 name="Compensation for other bodily harm"><a name="Compensation for other bodily harm">Compensation for other bodily harm</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2546"></a></p>

National law shall determine whether and to what extent the  manager or the carrier must pay damages for bodily harm other  than that provided for in Articles 11 and 12.<p><a name="P22S2547"></a></p><h4 name="Article 14"><a name="Article 14">Article 14</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2548"></a></p><h4 name="Form and amount of damages in case of death and personal  injury"><a name="Form and amount of damages in case of death and personal  injury">Form and amount of damages in case of death and personal  injury</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2549"></a></p>

§ 1 The damages provided for in Article 11 § 2 and in Article 
12 letter b) must be awarded in the form of a lump sum.  However, if national law permits the award of an annuity, the  damages shall be awarded in that form if so requested by the  injured person or by persons entitled referred to in Article 
11 § 2.<p><a name="P22S2550"></a></p>

§ 2 The amount of damages to be awarded pursuant to § 1 shall  be determined in accordance with national law. However, for  the purposes of these Uniform Rules, the upper limit per  person shall be set at 175,000 units of account as a lump sum  or as an annuity corresponding to that sum, where national  law provides for an upper limit of less than that amount.<p><a name="P22S2551"></a></p><h4 name="Article 15"><a name="Article 15">Article 15</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2552"></a></p><h4 name="Loss of right to invoke the limits of liability"><a name="Loss of right to invoke the limits of liability">Loss of right to invoke the limits of liability</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2553"></a></p>

The limits of liability provided for in these Uniform Rules  as well as the provisions of national law, which limit the  compensation to a certain amount, shall not apply if it is  proved that the loss or damage results from an act or  omission, which the author of the loss or damage has  committed either with the intent to cause such loss or  damage, or recklessly and with knowledge that such loss or  damage would probably result.<p><a name="P22S2554"></a></p><h4 name="Article 16"><a name="Article 16">Article 16</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2555"></a></p><h4 name="Conversion and interest"><a name="Conversion and interest">Conversion and interest</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2556"></a></p>

§ 1 Where the calculation of compensation requires the  conversion of sums expressed in foreign currency, conversion  shall be at the exchange rate applicable on the day and at  the place of payment of the compensation.<p><a name="P22S2557"></a></p>

§ 2 The person entitled may claim interest on compensation,  calculated at five per cent per annum, from the day of  initiation of a conciliation procedure, of seizure of the  Arbitration Tribunal provided for in Title V of the  Convention or from the day on which legal proceedings were  instituted.<p><a name="P22S2558"></a></p><h4 name="Article 17"><a name="Article 17">Article 17</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2559"></a></p><h4 name="Liability in case of nuclear incidents"><a name="Liability in case of nuclear incidents">Liability in case of nuclear incidents</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2560"></a></p>

The manager and the carrier shall be relieved of liability  pursuant to these Uniform Rules for loss or damage caused by  a nuclear incident when the operator of a nuclear  installation or another person who is substituted for him is  liable for the loss or damage pursuant to the laws and  prescriptions of a State governing liability in the field of  nuclear energy.<p><a name="P22S2561"></a></p><h4 name="Article 18"><a name="Article 18">Article 18</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2562"></a></p><h4 name="Liability for auxiliaries"><a name="Liability for auxiliaries">Liability for auxiliaries</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2563"></a></p>

The manager and the carrier shall be liable for their  auxiliaries.<p><a name="P22S2564"></a></p><h4 name="Article 19"><a name="Article 19">Article 19</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2565"></a></p><h4 name="Other actions"><a name="Other actions">Other actions</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2566"></a></p>

§ 1 In all cases where these Uniform Rules shall apply, any  action in respect of liability, on whatever grounds, may be  brought against the manager or against the carrier only  subject to the conditions and limitations laid down in these  Uniform Rules.<p><a name="P22S2567"></a></p>

§ 2 The same shall apply to any action brought against the  auxiliaries for whom the manager or the carrier is liable  pursuant to Article 18.<p><a name="P22S2568"></a></p><h4 name="Article 20"><a name="Article 20">Article 20</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2569"></a></p><h4 name="Agreements to settle"><a name="Agreements to settle">Agreements to settle</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2570"></a></p>

The parties to the contract may agree conditions in which  they assert or renounce their rights to compensation from the  other party to the contract.<p><a name="P22S2571"></a></p><h4 name="Title IV"><a name="Title IV">Title IV</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2572"></a></p><h4 name="Actions by Auxiliaries"><a name="Actions by Auxiliaries">Actions by Auxiliaries</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2573"></a></p><h4 name="Article 21"><a name="Article 21">Article 21</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2574"></a></p><h4 name="Actions against the manager or against the carrier"><a name="Actions against the manager or against the carrier">Actions against the manager or against the carrier</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2575"></a></p>

§ 1 Any action in respect of liability brought by the  auxiliaries of the carrier against the manager on account of  loss or damage caused by him, on whatever grounds, may be  brought only subject to the conditions and limitations laid  down in these Uniform Rules.<p><a name="P22S2576"></a></p>

§ 2 Any action in respect of liability brought by the  auxiliaries of the manager against the carrier on account of  loss or damage caused by him, on whatever grounds, may be  brought only subject to the conditions and limitations laid  down in these Uniform Rules.<p><a name="P22S2577"></a></p><h4 name="Title V"><a name="Title V">Title V</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2578"></a></p><h4 name="Assertion of Rights"><a name="Assertion of Rights">Assertion of Rights</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2579"></a></p><h4 name="Article 22"><a name="Article 22">Article 22</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2580"></a></p><h4 name="Conciliation procedures"><a name="Conciliation procedures">Conciliation procedures</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2581"></a></p>

The parties to the contract may agree conciliation procedures  or appeal to the Arbitration Tribunal provided for in Title V  of the Convention.<p><a name="P22S2582"></a></p><h4 name="Article 23"><a name="Article 23">Article 23</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2583"></a></p><h4 name="Recourse"><a name="Recourse">Recourse</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2584"></a></p>

The validity of the payment made by the carrier on the basis  of the CIV Uniform Rules or the CIM Uniform Rules may not be  disputed when compensation has been determined by a court or  tribunal and when the manager, duly served with notice of the  proceedings, has been afforded the opportunity to intervene  in the proceedings.<p><a name="P22S2585"></a></p><h4 name="Article 24"><a name="Article 24">Article 24</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2586"></a></p><h4 name="Forum"><a name="Forum">Forum</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2587"></a></p>

§ 1 Actions based on these Uniform Rules may be brought  before the courts or tribunals of the Member States  designated by agreement between the parties to the  contract.<p><a name="P22S2588"></a></p>

§ 2 Unless the parties to the contract otherwise  agree, the competent courts or tribunals shall be those of  the Member State where the manager has his place of  business.<p><a name="P22S2589"></a></p><h4 name="Article 25"><a name="Article 25">Article 25</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2590"></a></p><h4 name="Limitation of actions"><a name="Limitation of actions">Limitation of actions</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2591"></a></p>

§ 1 The period of limitation for actions based on these  Uniform Rules shall be three years.<p><a name="P22S2592"></a></p>

§ 2 The period of limitation shall run from the day when the  loss or damage occurred.<p><a name="P22S2593"></a></p>

§ 3 In case of death of persons, the period of limitation  shall be three years from the day after the day the death  occurred, but not exceeding five years from the day after the  day of the accident.<p><a name="P22S2594"></a></p>

§ 4 A recourse action by a person held liable may be brought  even after the expiration of the limitation period provided  for in § 1, if it is brought within the period allowed by the  law of the State where the proceedings are brought. However,  the period allowed shall be not less than ninety days from  the day when the person bringing the recourse action has  settled the claim or has been served with notice of the  proceedings against himself.<p><a name="P22S2595"></a></p>

§ 5 The period of limitation shall be suspended when the  parties agree a conciliation procedure or when they seize the  Arbitration Tribunal provided for in Title V of the  Convention.<p><a name="P22S2596"></a></p>

§ 6 Otherwise, suspension and interruption of the limitation  period shall be governed by national law.<p><a name="P22S2597"></a></p>

Enhetliga rättsregler för avtal om nyttjande av infrastruktur  i internationell järnvägstrafik (CUI, bihang E till  fördraget)<p><a name="P22S2598"></a></p><h4 name="Avdelning I"><a name="Avdelning I">Avdelning I</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2599"></a></p><h4 name="Allmänna bestämmelser"><a name="Allmänna bestämmelser">Allmänna bestämmelser</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2600"></a></p><i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2601"></a></p><h4 name="Artikel 1"><a name="Artikel 1">Artikel 1</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2602"></a></p><h4 name="Tillämpningsområde"><a name="Tillämpningsområde">Tillämpningsområde</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2603"></a></p>

§ 1 Dessa enhetliga rättsregler ska tillämpas på varje avtal  om nyttjande av järnvägsinfrastruktur för internationell  transport i den mening som avses i de enhetliga rättsreglerna  CIV och i de enhetliga rättsreglerna CIM, oavsett var  parterna i transportavtalet har sitt säte och vilken  nationalitet de har. Dessa enhetliga rättsregler ska även  tillämpas när järnvägsinfrastrukturen förvaltas eller nyttjas  av stater eller statliga institutioner eller organisationer.<p><a name="P22S2604"></a></p>

§ 2 Om inte annat följer av artikel 21, ska dessa enhetliga  rättsregler inte tillämpas på andra rättsförhållanden, såsom<br />
      a) transportörens eller förvaltarens ansvar gentemot sina  anställda eller andra personer vilkas tjänster de anlitar för  att genomföra sina uppgifter,<br />
      b) ansvaret mellan transportören eller förvaltaren och tredje  man.<p><a name="P22S2605"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2606"></a></p><h4 name="Artikel 1 "><a name="Artikel 1 ">Artikel 1 </a></h4><p><a name="P22S2607"></a></p><h4 name="Tillämpningsområde"><a name="Tillämpningsområde">Tillämpningsområde</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2608"></a></p>

§ 1 Dessa enhetliga rättsregler ska tillämpas på  varje avtal om nyttjande av järnvägsinfrastruktur 
(trafikeringsavtal) i en medlemsstat avseende internationell  järnvägstrafik för internationell transport i den mening som  avses i de enhetliga rättsreglerna CIV och i de enhetliga  rättsreglerna CIM.<p><a name="P22S2609"></a></p>

§ 2 Dessa enhetliga rättsregler ska tillämpas oavsett  avtalsparternas nationalitet eller var de har sitt säte.  Rättsreglerna ska även tillämpas när järnvägsinfrastrukturen  förvaltas eller nyttjas av stater eller statliga institutioner  eller organisationer.<p><a name="P22S2610"></a></p>

§ 3 Om inte annat följer av artikel 21, ska  dessa enhetliga rättsregler inte tillämpas på andra  rättsförhållanden, såsom<br />
      a) transportörens  eller förvaltarens ansvar gentemot sina anställda eller andra  personer vilkas tjänster de anlitar för att genomföra sina  uppgifter,<br />
      b) ansvaret mellan transportören eller  förvaltaren och tredje man.<p><a name="P22S2611"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2612"></a></p><h4 name="Artikel 2"><a name="Artikel 2">Artikel 2</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2613"></a></p><h4 name="Förklaring om ansvar vid personskada"><a name="Förklaring om ansvar vid personskada">Förklaring om ansvar vid personskada</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2614"></a></p>

§ 1 En stat får när som helst förklara att den inte kommer  att tillämpa samtliga bestämmelser om ansvar vid personskada  vid olyckor som inträffat på dess territorium, när de skadade  är medborgare i den staten eller har hemvist där.<p><a name="P22S2615"></a></p>

§ 2 En stat som har avgett en förklaring enligt § 1 får när  som helst återta den genom meddelande till depositarien.  Återtagandet får verkan en månad efter den dag då  depositarien underrättade medlemsstaterna om det.<br />
   ------------------------------------------------------------
<i><i>/Upphör att gälla U:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2616"></a></p><h4 name="Artikel 3"><a name="Artikel 3">Artikel 3</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2617"></a></p><h4 name="Definitioner"><a name="Definitioner">Definitioner</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2618"></a></p>

I dessa enhetliga rättsregler avses med<br />
      a) järnvägsinfrastruktur: alla järnvägslinjer och fasta  installationer om de är nödvändiga för trafik med  järnvägsfordon och för trafikens säkerhet,<br />
      b) förvaltare: den som ställer järnvägsinfrastruktur till  förfogande och som är ansvarig enligt gällande lagar och  föreskrifter i den stat där järnvägsinfrastrukturen är  belägen,<br />
      c) transportör: den som transporterar personer eller gods med  järnväg i internationell trafik enligt de enhetliga  rättsreglerna CIV eller de enhetliga rättsreglerna CIM och  som har en licens eller ett särskilt tillstånd i enlighet med  gällande lagar och bestämmelser i den stat där transporten  utförs avseende beviljande eller godkännande av sådana  licenser,<br />
      d) järnvägspersonal: anställda eller andra personer vilkas  tjänster transportören eller förvaltaren anlitar för att  genomföra avtalet när dessa anställda eller andra personer  handlar under fullgörande av sina uppgifter,<br />
      e) tredje man: varje annan person än förvaltaren,  transportören eller deras järnvägspersonal,<br />
      f) tillstånd: tillstånd meddelat av en stat till ett  järnvägsföretag, i enlighet med gällande lagar och  bestämmelser i den stat där transportörens verksamhet är  godkänd,<br />
      g) säkerhetsintyg: dokument som enligt lagar och bestämmelser  i den stat där infrastrukturen är belägen såvitt avser  transportören intygar att<br />
   - företagets interna organisation och<br />
   - den personal som ska anställas och de fordon som ska  nyttjas på den trafikerade infrastrukturen <p><a name="P22S2619"></a></p>

uppfyller de säkerhetskrav som fastställts i syfte att  garantera säker trafik på denna infrastruktur.<p><a name="P22S2620"></a></p><i><i>/Träder i kraft I:den dag som regeringen bestämmer/</i></i><p><a name="P22S2621"></a></p><h4 name="Artikel 3"><a name="Artikel 3">Artikel 3</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2622"></a></p><h4 name="Definitioner"><a name="Definitioner">Definitioner</a></h4><p><a name="P22S2623"></a></p>

I dessa enhetliga rättsregler avses med<br />
      a) järnvägsinfrastruktur: alla järnvägslinjer  och fasta installationer om de är nödvändiga för trafik med  järnvägsfordon och för trafikens säkerhet,<br />
aa) internationell  järnvägstrafik: trafik i vilken en internationell linje eller  flera nationella linjer belägna i minst två stater nyttjas och  som koordineras av de infrastrukturförvaltare eller organ som  svarar för tilldelningen av berörda tåglägen,<br />
      b) förvaltare: den som ställer järnvägsinfrastruktur  till förfogande och som är ansvarig enligt gällande lagar och  föreskrifter i den stat där järnvägsinfrastrukturen är  belägen,<br />
      c) transportör: den fysiska eller juridiska person som transporterar personer eller gods med järnväg i internationell  järnvägstrafik och som har en licens i enlighet med gällande lagar och bestämmelser rörande beviljande och godkännande av  licenser i den stat där verksamheten utförs,<br />
